name: Large archway in the centre nave of St. Paul's Church, Macao, after it was burnt (December 1835)
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view through a tall masonry arch to the ruined nave of St Paul's Church, which had been largely destroyed by fire in January 1835. Two soldiers can be seen by the remains of the baroque altarpiece. the altar is visible.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
